name: OSM Importer TF3 Vanilla (Preview)
summary: OSM import with road/rail height priority and experimental mapped small water.
description: Preview OSM importer. New imports use base terrain or explicitly sourced game elevations for networks, preserving accepted node heights. Mapped small waters use an experimental 0.5 m shallow bed and Landscaping Water Dirty; native validation is pending. Lake metadata is retained without flooding because no supported local sea-level command was found. A separate elevated flat model surface was rendered and reloaded in TF3; it is decorative, not navigable water. The old raised basin is disabled after native terrain spikes. Large real-world import still requires validation. No external mod dependencies. See README.txt.
